verdict.rationale: stagewise's documentation covers the IDE, agent features, BYOK and custom-provider setup, plus an llms.txt file. Nothing in the pack shows an interactive API reference with runnable examples, and the probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any candidate path. For a developer tool this axis applies, so missing evidence makes the verdict none rather than na.
